endpoints.GetSalariesV5: GET /DesktopModules/DailyFantasyApi/API/Fantasy/GetSalariesV5?site=1&sport=1&periodId={id} — full slate config: PositionFilters, LineupRequirements (roster + multipliers), LineupBudget, GenerateMethods (12 optimizer modes w/ exact descriptions), AdvancedOptions (23 optimizer params incl Max Exposure semantics), StackingOptions (5 stack types w/ params), MatchupData, AvgAdjustments, NewsSummary, Ownership.Projected + Ownership.ContestResults (per-contest player-owned%!), SalaryContainerJson (players w/ Proj PP/Ceil/Floor/Conf/Notes — sharp-note structured alerts), SalariesMap (per-slate salary ID lists + Variants w/ per-variant salary/position/salary-mult)
endpoints.GenerateLineup: POST optimizer (params encoded via AdvancedOptions/GenerateMethods ids)

public_access: GetSalariesV5 returns 200 unauthenticated (verified). Ownership data = REAL per-contest field ownership from tracked contests (ContestResults[].OwnershipData[] player-level Owned%)

generate_methods.Name: Highest Projected
generate_methods.Description: Generates lineups with the highest number of projected points.

generate_methods.Name: High Leverage
generate_methods.Description: Optimizes lineups with the highest leverage players to follow low owned high scoring players. *Tournaments*

generate_methods.Name: High Safety
generate_methods.Description: Optimizes lineups with the highest owned players to follow the field. *Double-Ups*

generate_methods.Name: Tournament - GPP
generate_methods.Description: This model favors high leverage players with high ceilings. Lineups will have lower ownership for high risk and reward.

generate_methods.Name: Double Ups
generate_methods.Description: This model favors higher owned players. Lineups will have higher ownership which will follow the crowd.

generate_methods.Name: Daily Matchup
generate_methods.Description: More heavily favors players with the best matchups based on our Matchups page.

generate_methods.Name: Predictable & Consistent
generate_methods.Description: Places more value on players who have been predictable. *Double-Ups*

generate_methods.Name: High Ceiling
generate_methods.Description: Fills lineups with players that have shown the ability to score big. This is a riskier option but can pay off. *Tournaments*

generate_methods.Name: High Floor
generate_methods.Description: Fills lineups with players that don't score low.

generate_methods.Name: Boom Bust Random
generate_methods.Description: Optimizes lineups that will randomly give players their ceiling or floor scores.

generate_methods.Name: Stars and Scrubs
generate_methods.Description: Fills the lineups with as many high salary studs as possible. *Tournaments*

generate_methods.Name: Points Per Game
generate_methods.Description: Use PPG value from daily site in place of our projections.

advanced_options.Desc: Select the number of lineups you want generated.

advanced_options.Desc: Max Exposure limits the number of times a player will be included in a lineup set. At 70% Max Exposure, with 10 lineups a player will be in at most 7 lineups.
advanced_options.Name: Max Exposure

advanced_options.Desc: Set the max exposure limit per position. This takes priority over the standard exposure if a position matches.
advanced_options.Name: Position Exposure

advanced_options.Desc: Your liked Players can exceed the Max Exposure value.
advanced_options.Name: Liked Exposure

advanced_options.Desc: Set the maxmium total projected ownership you want for optimized lineups.
advanced_options.Name: Lineup pOwn% Max

advanced_options.Desc: Projected Individual Ownership Range for players to be used when optimizing lineups.
advanced_options.Name: pOwn% Range

advanced_options.Desc: Your liked players will recieve a projection boost while optimizing lineups. Higher projections will generally include those players in more lineups.
advanced_options.Name: Liked Projection Boost

advanced_options.Desc: Your liked players become your player pool. IMPORTANT: Make sure you have enough players liked to cover every position and your exposure settings otherwise lineups can't be built.
advanced_options.Name: Liked Player Pool
